article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Pace Prosser had 32 points, seven assists and six rebounds, Trent Egbiremolen scored 22 points and Siena beat Vermont 98-88 on Tuesday. Egbiremolen made 6 of 11 from the floor, 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and 8 for 8 from the free-throw line, and added eight rebounds and five assists for the Saints (5-2). Tim Ibukunoluwa shot 3 for 11 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 10 of 10 from the free-throw line to finish with 17 points. Will Davies led the Catamounts (3-4) in scoring, finishing with 23 points, six rebounds and eight assists. Noah Barnett added 19 points for Vermont. Darrel Yepdo also had 18 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
